rationale: Reorganizes Device settings into five shared sections plus actual profile tabs, preserves canonical display and save owners, and replaces manual radar declaration with a compatibility entry for saved data.

summary.ru: Настройки устройства: пять общих разделов, профильные вкладки, реальное превью и единое оформление с темами Home Assistant.
summary.en: Device settings gain five consistent sections, real profile tabs, canonical previews and shared Home Assistant themed controls.
